argument: The missing edge must be real geometry: a single open SVG path must transfer its gap and alter source, target, and remote relay points after a drawn span. A marker, glow, or extra connector cannot substitute.

With labels, stations, controls, readout, captions, and furniture hidden, the first field should read as one luminous broken boundary, not a closed body, route diagram, linefield, or disguised control ring. After a span, the moved rupture must be findable in the silhouette.

Pointerdown may arm but cannot write. A continuous pointerup at a distinct station must commit; same-station contact is refused. Delete must reconstruct the exact preceding contour and R must release bounded route memory.
The little-critters mechanism is translated from local reciprocal looking into a route-dependent topology. No animal, eye, character, or head-turning image may carry the relation.

Delete v025 if the line is only a polished loop, if the gap does not migrate, if a route commits without a distinct target, if the relay is always a fixed neighbour, or if the caption is needed to see the rule.
